nodes.title: Standard Agent Loop
nodes.summary: Harness owns context serialization and tool execution; the reasoning model decides when to call tools and when to answer.

nodes.title: DeepSeek Config-Driven Harness
nodes.summary: External reference for live configuration, validated tool registration and hot-reload patterns.

nodes.title: Brew Existing Tool Registry
nodes.summary: Brew already owns source-contained tool.json manifests, validation, dynamic imports and explicit registration through one capability registry.

nodes.title: Live Local-Tool Reload
nodes.summary: Extend the existing Brew registry so validated local-tool source changes can be reloaded without restarting the runtime.

nodes.title: Config-Owned Reasoning / Policy
nodes.summary: Do not move reasoning, approval, safety policy or canonical execution authority into live configuration.
